title: Curried Cashew, Pear, and Grape Salad
description: This cashew and pear salad is loaded with nuts, fruit and greens, with the kick of curry and cayenne pepper. My family calls it "The Good Salad."
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste

steps.text: In a large, dry skillet over medium-high heat, toast cashews until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Remove cashews to a dish to cool slightly.

Return skillet to medium-high heat, cook bacon strips until crisp on both sides, about 7 minutes. Remove bacon with a slotted spoon, and soak up grease with a paper towel. Coarsely chop bacon, and set aside.
In a medium bowl, stir together butter, rosemary, curry powder, brown sugar, salt, cayenne pepper, and toasted cashews. Set aside.
In a small bowl, stir together white wine vinegar, mustard, and honey. Slowly whisk in olive oil, and sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste.
In a large salad bowl, toss dressing with greens, pear slices, grapes, and bacon, and sprinkle with nut mixture.

video.description: In this video, you'll see how to make a delicious and healthy green salad that’s loaded with good stuff! Mixed greens mix it up with spiced cashews, sliced pear, red grapes, and cashews in a honey, vinegar, and Dijon dressing. The cashews get a spicy curry and cayenne pepper treatment. There’s even some crisp bacon in there.
